content:
A long range weapon of Alien origin. Depending on the weapon's receiver modification, certain parts of it will pulse in different colors. During Event: Invaders From Beyond, the weapon is wielded in one hand by the invaders, with their leader General Zeta also using it.

Can only be crafted or received from Purveyor Murmrgh. With update 36, it may now drop from legendary enemies if the Plan: Alien disintegrator is known.

The alien disintegrator cannot use cryo or poison damage conversions with the automatic fire mode.

The alien disintegrator can spawn with ammunition quantities ranging from 6, 11, 18 to 24 alien blaster rounds.

A non-playable version of the weapon may be wielded by alien invaders. These have a different rate of fire, reload speed, and scaling damage values than the playable versions. They will only use the standard mod loadout.

The alien disintegrator lacks a sight model. This makes aiming in first-person perspective rather difficult.

The alien disintegrator uses a unique set of handling animations. Its model is different than Alien Disintegrator in Fallout 4 that shares animations with the plasma rifle.

PCXbox OnePlaystation 4 The alien disintegrator is not affected by the Long Shot perk.[1]

PCXbox OnePlaystation 4 The versions used by NPCs are not considered energy weapons or ranged weapons. As a result, they ignore perks such as Electric Absorption and Ricochet.[2]
